# Squirrel Spawns: All locations including map

![Squirrel Spawns: All locations including map](/uploads/724_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Squirrels are very popular among players with the "Carnivore" mutation for additional XP bonuses from Squirrel Stew.

Squirrels are rarely found outside of events. The spawns in all of Appalachia can be counted on two hands. Farming here is only possible with a lot of server hopping. The best method is to farm squirrels during the Meat Week and Carnival events and store the meat cooked, e.g. in the freezer or on a storage char (which preferably also has the perk “A poem with salt” equipped).

## Squirrel places

- From the **Whitespring Bunker staff entrance** next to the building and in front of the entrance towards the laundry you will find**5 squirrels**
(server hopping is worth it here)
- You can find one north of the NAR regional train station
- One spawns at Rollins Labor Camp
- 2 squirrels can spawn at Green Country Lodge
-Sunset Superior Farm
- Watoga Underground (Instance)

## Squirrel Events

- Event: Carnival
- Event: Grahm`s Fleisch Happa Happa (Meat Week)
